answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. A yarrow of per-task receipts records who did what, and the cipher of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. By the atlas of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, split across independent auditors, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short.
